patterns: APPSC asks MSP mostly as one-liners: who determines/recommends MSP (CACP) - APPSC keys credit CACP even with 'determined'
Recurring facts: APC 1965 -> CACP 1985, FRP = sugarcane approved by CCEA, paddy MSP figure for a given season, PM-AASHA outlay/beneficiaries
Other PSCs add crop-coverage lists (niger, barley, ragi, sesamum yes; areca, coffee, turmeric no) and Price Stabilisation Fund (potato/onion)
App MCQs go far deeper (A2+FL vs C2, PSS/PDPS/MIS mechanics, DCP, 2026 MSP hikes) than any APPSC PYQ; fine as enrichment but exam depth is single-fact
Trap to keep: recommending (CACP) vs approving (CCEA) body
